name: L1
description: L0 plus exactly one domain tool: the map-and-move CLI on PATH-equivalent absolute path, described in one paragraph of the prompt.
flags: You are a coding agent. Use the shell to complete the task.
prompt_prefix: A tool is available for moving Python modules safely: `python {TOOL} --plan plan.json --root . --yes --no-commit --dry-run` (drop --dry-run to apply). plan.json is {"moves":[{"from":"pkg/a.py","to":"pkg/sub/a.py"}]}. It moves the files, creates missing __init__.py files and rewrites the import statements it can find. Check its result yourself: it does not catch every import form.
